talks.title: A practical guide to collaborative editing
talks.speaker: Ximena Moreau
talks.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with collaborative editing and how we fixed them. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. We expect around 32 attendees.
